name: @pipeworx/mcp-turbulence-modeling-resource

tools.name: tmr_cases
tools.description: Catalog of NASA Langley Turbulence Modeling Resource (TMR) verification and validation cases for turbulence models — flat plates, bumps-in-channel, airfoils (NACA 0012, NACA 4412), axisymmetric jets, a backward-facing step, the NASA wall-mounted hump, shock/boundary-layer interactions, a supersonic square duct, the ONERA M6 wing, and a high-Reynolds-number channel flow. Each entry gives the case id to pass to tmr_reference_data, its category (verification vs. validation), flow regime, and documented Mach/Reynolds conditions.

category.description: Filter to one category. Omit for all cases.

tools.name: tmr_reference_data
tools.description: Reference data (an experimental measurement or an established correlation, e.g. skin-friction coefficient Cf or lift/drag vs. angle of attack) for one NASA Langley Turbulence Modeling Resource case, as published by the case's own data file. Only available for a subset of cases — call tmr_cases first and check "reference_data: true" — because most TMR case directories hold dozens of individual turbulence-model CFD result files alongside the reference data, and this tool only serves files the case page itself unambiguously labels as the reference/experimental data.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-turbulence-modeling-resource forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the turbulence-modeling-resource pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
